In this versatile role, you are the central interface between technology, rental and customers – and bring structure into a dynamic everyday life. You process and control service and rental orders in the ERP system You ensure correct and clean recording and billing of assembly, service and repair services

• You accompany the entire rental process – from the acceptance of the order to the return of the equipment
• You support with inventories as well as with the monthly rental invoicing that you bring with

• Enjoying coordination, technical proximity and teamwork You can look forward to this

• A motivated team that tackles together

• Vous supportez avec des inventaires ainsi qu'avec la facturation mensuelle de location que vous apportez
• Formation commerciale terminée (EFZ)
• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand, le français est un avantage
